## Statement

Type the problem statement here. You do not need to include figures.

## Solution

Type your solution following the [Elements of Style for proofs](https://www.utica.edu/faculty_staff/xixiao/ElementsOfStyle.pdf). Use LaTeX commands to get math to appear, remember to use single dollar signs for inline math, and double dollar signs for centered math, as in $\int_a^b f(x) dx$ or $$\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}.$$

You can include code chunks, as needed, to perform computations. If you have a working installation of python on your machine, you include python computations directly in your work.
